topic: Brief about special checks on VVIP/VIP aircraft
syllabus_extract: Brief about special checks on VVIP/VIP aircraft
specific_objectives: 4.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to explain flight safety organization and its functions

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of VVIP checklists and safety protocols; Safety precautions include strict adherence to security zones; Instructor supervision ensures correct identification of special check items.
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between standard and VVIP aircraft checks?
Which organization is responsible for flight safety in the Indian Air Force?
List three key functions of the flight safety organization.

topics: Definition of VVIP and VIP aircraft
development.content:
Definition of VVIP and VIP aircraft
Role of Flight Safety Organization
Special pre-flight inspection items
Security clearance procedures
Post-flight reporting requirements

Detailed VVIP checklist components
Emergency equipment verification
Communication system checks
Crew briefing protocols
Documentation and form A-2 usage

Handling of sensitive cargo
Coordination with ground security
Incident reporting mechanisms
Maintenance record updates
Final walk-around inspection

summary_questions: Explain the specific function of the flight safety organization during VVIP operations.
Describe the critical steps involved in the post-flight reporting for a VVIP aircraft.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a summary of the transfer procedure for a VVIP aircraft, referencing the use of form A-2 as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 11).

pft_rows.syllabus: Transfer procedure of aircraft, aero engines and power plant and documentation, use of form A-2. A-11, A-53 IN-324 and action for demands/ pending store transfer on ILMS (Air).
